Start with a "halfway" step: sit beside Milo's bed until he falls asleep, then move to the doorway over the next few nights, and gradually out of the room. At 5, most kids do best when the change is slow and predictable, with a short consistent bedtime routine they can count on.

Want the full night-by-night plan for moving Milo to his own bed? Reply YES and I'll send it.
